Union Minister Inspects Delhi-Mumbai Expressway

Union Minister Nitin Gadkari inspected a section of the Delhi-Mumbai Expressway. He traveled by road from Delhi to Kota to personally assess the progress and quality of the expressway. This inspection is part of ongoing efforts to monitor the development of the significant infrastructure project.
